about: The checkers compared, their pinned versions and configurations (the same for every comparison here).

tools.name: Granted
tools.config: Its library call, as its command-line tool makes it: one page per scan, its default core tests, no AI. Results are its own per-criterion table.

tools.name: axe-core
tools.config: `axe.run` with its defaults on the loaded page; violations only.

tools.name: Lighthouse
tools.config: The accessibility category only, desktop settings; an audit that scores 0 is a failure; each audit in its own process and browser.

tools.name: IBM Equal Access
tools.config: Ruleset IBM_Accessibility; only "violation" and "fail" results, the checker's default fail levels.

tools.name: QualWeb
tools.config: ACT rules and WCAG techniques modules; only "failed" outcomes; one QualWeb instance per page.
